descriptionMarkdown:
3.2 Ogryn Abhuman
Ogryns are massive abhumans used by the Imperium as 
shock troops, bodyguards, line-breakers, and
living siege weapons. They are loyal and terrifyingly 
durable, but they are not subtle and struggle with
equipment designed for normal human frames.
Ability Scores: +2 Strength, +1 Constitution.
Size: Medium, but you count as one size larger for 
carrying, lifting, pushing, dragging, grappling, and
shoving.
Speed: 30 ft.
Available Classes: Ogryn Skullbreaker only.
3.2.1 Ogryn Traits
Massive Build: Your maximum hit points increase by 3 
per character level. You also count as one size
larger for carrying, lifting, pushing, dragging, grappling, 
and shoving.
Thick Skull: You have advantage on saving throws 
against being frightened.
Brute Strength: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 + your 
Strength modifier bludgeoning damage.
Too Big for Standard Kit: You cannot use most 
standard armour, delicate weapons, compact firearms,
or subtle tools unless they have been modified for Ogryn 
use.
Simple Solutions: You are not automatically stupid, but 
you struggle with delicate logic, subtle
interfaces, encrypted systems, and advanced technology. 
You have disadvantage on Intelligence checks
involving advanced technology, forbidden lore, cogitators, 
security systems, encrypted data, or complex
machinery unless you are proficient in a relevant skill or 
tool. However, once per short rest, when a
problem could plausibly be solved through brute force, 
intimidation, endurance, or direct action, you
may add your proficiency bonus to the check even if you 
would not normally be proficient.
